sentences.text:
Public Prosecutor Hn, J Crl.P.No.6557_2025 The Court made the following
Order:
1. A Crime in F.I.R.No.227 of 2021 has been registered in Tenali I Town Police
Station, Guntur District, against the petitioner under Sections 188, 272, 273, 420 of
the Ipc and 20(2) of the Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003.
2. A learned Single Judge of this Court by an order dated 21.07.2020 in
Crl.P.No.2408 of 2020
has already held that as far as the provisions of the Food Safety Standards Act, 2006 is concerned, the same cannot be investigated or a complaint be taken up by the police.
The learned Single Judge also held mere transport or tobacco or tobacco products would not amount to an offence under Sections 270 and 273 of IPC.
